Following capture at the hands of the [[Yuuzhan Vong]], former [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Old Republic]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Darth Krayt|A'Sharad Hett]] '''escaped from imprisonment''' and fled to [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]], quickly taking the name Darth Krayt and founding the [[One Sith]].

==Prelude==
Following the [[Order 66/Legends|fall]] of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] at the end of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Darth Krayt|A'Sharad Hett]] returned to his home planet of [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], where he took command of an army of [[Tusken Raider/Legends|Tusken Raiders]] before being [[Duel on Tatooine (Imperial Period)|defeated]] by fellow [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]]-in-exile [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]]. Exiled from his home, Hett eventually arrived on the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] world of [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]] and discovered the [[XoXaan's holocron|holocron]] of [[XoXaan]], one of the original [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lords of the Sith]], and chose to learn the ways of the Sith from it.<ref name="Legacy 17">[[Legacy (2006) 17|''Legacy'' (2006) 17]]</ref> Hett eventually emerged to find the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] had fallen due to the efforts of [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]], leaving him unable to take revenge against the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lords]] who destroyed the Jedi: [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] and [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]]. Feeling robbed, Hett fled to the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]], only to be captured by a [[Species/Legends|race]] of [[Yuuzhan Vong galaxy|extra-galactic]] beings known as the Yuuzhan Vong. Upon capture, Hett was brutally tortured, experimented on and imprisoned in a torture device known as the [[Embrace of Pain]]. There, he encountered [[Vergere]], a Jedi from before the Clone Wars who secretly trained as a Sith under Darth Sidious. There, the two discussed the future of the Sith Order, with Hett believing that an army of Sith would be best to bring order to the galaxy while Vergere preferred to follow [[Darth Bane/Legends|Darth Bane's]] [[Rule of Two/Legends|Rule of Two]]. Unable to agree and deciding he was a lost cause, Vergere left Hett to the Yuuzhan Vong as she went to assist in preparation for their [[Yuuzhan Vong War|attack]] on [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="Legacy 18" />

==The Escape==
Alone, Hett waited until he was strong enough in the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]] to escape his torment. During the process, the former Jedi attacked his captors with [[Force lightning/Legends|Force lightning]] and stole a [[Yorik-et]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] to flee the ship. In order to keep his survival a secret, Hett destroyed the scout ship, killing everyone on board before retreating back to Korriban. There, he took on the name [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] Krayt, after the reptilian [[Krayt dragon/Legends|predators]] from his homeworld. Finishing his training, he founded a new generation of Sith, the [[One Sith]], while the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] was distracted by the Yuuzhan Vong and their invasion. Over time, he and his followers continued to build up strength before [[Sith–Imperial War|emerging]] and [[Attack on Emperor Fel|taking over the galaxy]], with Krayt becoming [[Sith Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] of a reborn [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire|Galactic Empire]]. He would later tell [[Cade Skywalker]] of his escape while torturing him in an Embrace of Pain over a century later.<ref name="Legacy 18" />
